name: Wick Palmer
source: Born August 18, 213 FE, on the space colony Selene. Recognized from an early age as a pilot prodigy and drafted immediately upon turning 18. His incredible natural performance in simulated combat has resulted in his being assigned one of the most powerful mechs in the OFS fleet, the Melchior Y formerly piloted by Armond Temperance, a storied war hero.
